name: diffuspace/clover-35b-a3b-preview
title: Clover-35B-A3B-Preview: open-weight block-diffusion MoE LLM with strong agent coding scores
summary: DiffuSpace, the team behind HKU's Dream 7B, released an Apache-2.0 diffusion language model: 35B total parameters, about 3B active, 128K context. It is initialized from Qwen3.6-35B-A3B and generates in 32-token blocks that are denoised in parallel. Self-reported scores: SWE-bench Verified 73.6, Terminal-Bench 2.1 51.7 and GPQA Diamond 83.8, all ahead of the same-size Qwen AR models and of LLaDA2.2
